name: Tech Innovation Fest
description: A technology-focused festival where students present their creative ideas and technical skills. Participants showcase robotics projects, develop software, demonstrate applications, participate in coding competitions, and present innovative inventions.

name: Art and Photography Festival
description: A creative festival where students display their artistic abilities. Participants exhibit paintings, drawings, digital artwork, and photographs. They can also join art competitions, live sketching sessions, and photography challenges.

name: Food Festival
description: A festival where students explore different cuisines and cooking traditions. Participants set up food stalls, prepare traditional dishes, sell snacks, participate in cooking competitions, and allow visitors to taste different foods.

name: Talent Show Festival
description: A festival where students demonstrate their unique talents and abilities. Participants perform singing, dancing, acting, magic tricks, comedy, poetry, and other creative performances in front of an audience.
